summary: Drop the `user groups` command and its MCP tool; there is no account-to-groups endpoint on DSM 7.1.1.
reason: `SYNO.Core.User.Group` implements only `join` on DSM 7.1.1 and answers `list` with error 103, so the generated command could never return anything. The reverse lookup is `group list` plus `group members`, both of which work, and shipping a permanently broken command is worse than not shipping it.
validated_outcome: Regeneration from the corrected spec omits the `user_groups` command and its MCP tool; `group list` plus `group members` cover the lookup against a live DS415+.
